files.description: Absent or null means protected file transfer is unsupported. Do not infer support from the backend name.

AppComputerLifecyclePolicy.description: The recorded service policy for this computer. Absent or null means unavailable; clients must not invent timing or memory guarantees.

stopped_retention_ms.description: Recorded maximum time to keep a stopped computer, in milliseconds. Zero means delete after the observed stop. Current operator/account limits can shorten this time; absent or null means unavailable.

AppComputerResourceCapabilities.description: The bound computer's supported operations. Absent or null means unknown. A known object defaults omitted memory_suspend and command_sessions declarations to false; a Suspend profile alone does not promise memory preservation.

command.description: Shell command. Do not put credentials in command text.

credential_ref.description: Optional reference prepared by the server for this account, computer, command, and request key. Credential values cannot be sent here. It expires after ten minutes. Credentials stay in memory; a restart can make a waiting command fail.

cwd.description: Existing directory relative to the computer workspace; traversal and symlink escape refuse.

env.description: Non-secret values only. Names: LANG, LC_ALL, TZ, CI, TERM, or OA_PARAM_*; credential fields refuse.

idempotency_key.description: Required here or as Idempotency-Key. Reuse across retries.

chat.description: An existing chat owned by this account.

egress_profile.description: Use an exact name@sha256:digest selection from capabilities. Unavailable selections are refused.

enrolled_host.description: Reserved. Non-null host selections are currently refused.

idempotency_key.description: Required here or in Idempotency-Key; both must match. Keep the key bound to the immutable request after completion or deletion.

placement.description: The service uses the kind you choose or refuses the request. You cannot add a computer you already own here yet.

version.description: The saved version number, paired with environment.

command_key.description: The exact request key of the command that may use these credentials.

idempotency_key.description: Save this key with these exact settings before sending. Retries do not extend the expiry.

rule.description: One destination rule registered for that connection.

source.description: A source connection authorized for this account or workspace. Cloud secret paths are not accepted.

ttl_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime. Stop, wake, revocation, command exit, and broker restart also end access.

appBearer.description: A live app sess_ session or oa_sk_ sign-in key. Account-bound oak_ keys are accepted only where the operation declares them and their scopes permit it. API cookies are ignored.

get.description: Existing account and current workspace memberships. Accepts app sess_ sessions, oa_sk_ sign-in keys, and account-bound oak_ API keys. Credential prefixes alone do not prove authorization.

Origin, if supplied, must match this deployment.

Requires an awake computer; never wakes or allocates. Returns a bounded complete read after taking a read lease and checking file size and modification metadata. Files open for writing return409; files that cannot take a lease are unsupported. Concurrent changes can return409. File mode is not altered.

parameters.description: Relative UTF-8 path beneath the command workspace. No empty or dot components, controls, backslashes, colon, percent signs, symlinks, or mount crossings. Parents must already exist.
parameters.name: path

200.description: Complete binary file; X-Content-SHA256 and ETag identify the returned bytes.

ETag.description: The same SHA256 in double quotes.

X-Content-SHA256.description: Lowercase SHA256 of the complete binary response.

404.description: Computer, file, or parent directory missing.

409.description: Computer is not awake, or the file changed during the read.

412.description: Create-only upload conflicts with a different file.

429.description: Two transfers are in progress; retry after one second.

501.description: Protected files are unsupported on this computer.

503.description: Transfer unavailable; a write may have completed, so read and verify before retrying.

put.description: Requires awake computer, Content-Length, and SHA256. Validates the full body before writing. Publishes a same-directory temporary file by atomic rename; partial or mismatched uploads leave the previous file intact. Missing parents return404. Maximum4MiB, two transfers per instance,60second upload and60second execution bounds. A lost response can leave the result uncertain: read and compare SHA256 before retrying. Files stay on this computer's disk and are not shared artifacts.
